title: CounterSteer: Suppressing Indirect Prompt Injection with Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2609.36570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Indirect prompt injection makes an LLM agent treat untrusted retrieved text as instructions. We present CounterSteer, an inference-time defense that suppresses this behavior inside the model. Per model, a five-step recipe fits a residual-stream direction from paired episodes differing only in whether an embedded instruction is followed, and retains it only if it passes pre-specified causal and capability gates. At deployment, the direction is subtracted from every tool-result token during prefill. The edit is always on--there is no detection decision to evade--and requires no fine-tuning, auxiliary model, or added tokens, only white-box serving and tool-result span boundaries. translated_title: CounterSteer：利用激活导向抑制间接提示注入
translated_abstract: 间接提示注入会使大语言模型（LLM）智能体将不可信的检索文本当作指令来执行。我们提出了CounterSteer，这是一种在模型内部抑制该行为的推理时防御方法。针对每个模型，通过一个五步流程，从仅在“是否遵循嵌入指令”上存在差异的配对情景中拟合出一个残差流方向，并且仅当该方向通过预先设定的因果性和能力门槛时才予以保留。在部署时，该方向会在预填充（prefill）阶段从每个工具结果token中减去。这种编辑始终开启——不存在可供攻击者规避的检测决策——并且无需微调、辅助模型或添加额外token，只需要白盒推理服务和工具结果跨度的边界信息。在五个开源权重模型（8B至106B，涵盖五个厂商谱系）上，held-out攻击成功率从无防御时的0.21-1.00降至有防御时的0.00-0.17，AgentDojo攻陷率从0.10-0.49降至0.006-0.079，同时保持93-100%的排版归一化良性实用性，且规模较大的模型……
tldr: CounterSteer提出一种始终开启、无需微调的推理时防御方法，通过在残差流中拟合并减去一个“遵循嵌入指令”的方向，将LLM智能体的间接提示注入攻击成功率从0.21-1.00降至0.00-0.17，同时保持93-100%的良性任务实用性。
en_tdlr: CounterSteer is an always-on, fine-tuning-free inference-time defense that suppresses indirect prompt injection by fitting and subtracting an instruction-following direction in the residual stream, cutting held-out attack success from 0.21-1.00 to 0.00-0.17 while retaining 93-100% benign utility.
